name: Vinyl Vault of Precolonial Beats
description: A subterranean record vault where every groove predates the building storing it.
environment_gags: Albums are shelved by geological era.
The turntable spins at the speed of lineage.

jokes.setup: Why won't DJ Love digitize the vault?
jokes.punchline: DJ Love: 'You cannot compress what was never made of bits. The beat predates the format.'

jokes.setup: Q drops the needle on a record older than the stars.
jokes.punchline: Q: 'Only God can judge me. But this B-side can.'

interactions: Request a beat from before your ancestors.
Let Q remix a punchline in base-three.
